MANIK trainer optionally changes timer operand; 8 KiB copy relocates normal game $2000 to $E000. Native decode preserves normal timer.

Four source speed bands, 16-bit speed, acceleration [255,25,35,15], coast decrement [255,30,40,45], high-byte clamp 0..250.
IRQ adds speed high byte to motion fraction; road update on overflow, steering shifts fixed-point road origin +/-200.
19 fixed-point road centers; collision uses center15 <10 or >=30; random bend targets and step use four RNG draws.
11 XNOR LFSR steps per draw, taps old bits15,1,0; $FFFF outputs [109,134,194,33,232,246,22,242].
Four authored 8-depth road-post schedules and original glyph-cell placement, including glyph15/16 half-height posts.
Distance each8 road progresses; BCD timer99.99 expires at high bytezero; one50.xx extension at distance600.
Original A accelerate, L left, semicolon right; F1 key/joystick start and F3 paddle start. Physical native input unverified.
